angle: Unlike other counting-probability materials that classify with-or-without-order schemes or coefficients, this one builds the without-replacement idea entirely through a draw-by-draw candy handful that ends in a rare-or-rarer p-value.
angle_detail: Start with [00:51]–[02:57] because the shrinking-fraction conditional chain shows sampling without replacement concretely. Then watch [03:44]–[04:38] for the p-value as the total over equally rare or rarer outcomes, noting the video asserts the final value rather than enumerating every case.
